item.title: Tokematic 1.2.4196
item.description:
• Session Map now matches the web Session Map with inline search, period and project filters, collapsible Highlights totals, Detail / Area by / Group by button bars, interactive vendor toggles and the web tile skin.
  • Titled windows and utility panels now keep visible minimize and zoom traffic-light buttons, disabling them where resizing or minimizing does not apply.
  • CLI tools and in-app sign-ins work without extra macOS permissions. Browser and desktop app sign-ins require opt-in under Settings, General, Access, and Safari sign-ins remain separate.
  • Setup Wizard opens automatically at launch only when no working accounts are found.
  • Kimi CLI discovery and background refresh read only from your local CLI configuration and credentials.
  • Due to Apple App Store rules, Tokematic now uses a new application identifier. Your local history, settings and saved keys come with you.
  • After a verified Move, Hosted and iCloud sync resume automatically with your existing account and group choice. Update your other Tokematic devices too so they can share new history.
